form.label: Metrics & trends
form.description: Explore explicitly scoped item history and closed-hour trend aggregates.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: Explore explicitly scoped item history and closed-hour trend aggregates.

html.p: Configure item IDs in a dedicated input. Numeric, character, log and text history are supported; binary history is opt-in on Zabbix 7.0+. History values may contain sensitive operational data.

search.query: `zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:history (value_type=0 OR value_type=3) | dedup event_uid | eval series=instance.":".itemid | timechart span=5m avg(value) by series limit=12
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:trends | dedup event_uid | eval series=instance.":".itemid | timechart span=1h avg(value_avg) by series limit=12

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:history (value_type=1 OR value_type=2 OR value_type=4) | dedup event_uid | table _time instance itemid value raw.source raw.severity raw.logeventid
